summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Booking Emails + Self-Service Manage Booking feature. All backend APIs and frontend flows validated successfully.
passed_tests: POST /api/crm/booking - Creates appointment with long random manage_token, returns ok + appointment_id, confirmation email recorded
GET /api/crm/booking/slots - Returns list of ISO slot strings for available times
GET /api/crm/booking/manage/{token} - Returns public view fields (appt_type, type_label, duration_minutes, modality, start_at, end_at, status, name, when_label), 404 for bogus tokens

POST /api/crm/booking/manage/{token}/reschedule - Updates start_at/end_at, records rescheduled_at, clears reminder_sent_at, schedules rescheduled email, rejects past times (400) and clashing times (409)
POST /api/crm/booking/manage/{token}/cancel - Sets status=cancelled, prevents further reschedules (400)
POST /api/cron/booking-reminders - Requires Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET (401 without), returns {ok, checked, sent}, no double-send guarantee verified
Frontend - Shows appointment summary (manage-summary) with type, duration, modality, time
Frontend - Shows 'Pick a new time' and 'Cancel meeting' buttons
Frontend - Reschedule flow: loads slot grid (manage-slot-grid), selects slot, confirms new time, shows success notice
Frontend - Cancel flow: confirms cancellation, updates status to cancelled, hides action buttons, shows cancellation notice
Frontend - Invalid token shows proper error message
